items.difficulty_reason: The lemma constructs the Kunneth spectral sequence computing the derived tensor product of two bounded complexes, with second page given by Tor of the cohomology groups, and the proof is a 21-line construction by reindexing. It represents the two complexes by explicit complexes, filters them by truncations so that the associated graded pieces are the cohomology groups shifted, applies the filtered-proposition of the same section to obtain a first-quadrant spectral sequence with an explicit first page, and then reindexes the bidegrees so that the differentials have the announced bidegree and the second page becomes the Tor expression of the statement. The truncation step and the reindexing are the substance, and both are displayed.
